label: START SMART
title: Before you
spend money…
text: Before you spend money starting a business, prove someone wants what you're selling. Here's where to start.

label: 01 / FIND A PROBLEM
title: One customer.
One real problem.
text: One: pick a specific customer and a problem they already care about. Who are you helping?

label: 02 / TEST DEMAND
title: Talk before
you build.
text: Two: talk to potential buyers. Check competitors. Test a simple version before building the whole thing.

label: 03 / DEFINE YOUR OFFER
title: One offer.
One clear result.
text: Three: define one clear offer: what you deliver, what it costs, and why someone should choose you.

label: 04 / CHECK THE NUMBERS
title: Will the
numbers work?
text: Four: estimate startup costs, monthly expenses, and profit per sale. Know how you'll fund the gap.

label: 05 / HANDLE THE SETUP
title: Set it up
properly.
text: Five: check local registration, tax, permit, and insurance requirements. Separate business finances and track every expense.

label: 06 / LAUNCH SMALL
title: Launch.
Learn. Improve.
text: Six: launch small, find your first customers, and improve from their feedback before spending more.

title: Ready to
